speed_measurement: Mean Ultralytics Results.speed['inference'] (forward-pass ms/image). Same value repeated across thresholds for a given model/size.
matching_rule: Class-aware, highest-confidence-first, one-to-one box matching at ground-truth IoU>=match_iou; micro precision/recall, including negative images.
note: Validation-only; do not use test data for configuration selection. mAP uses separate low-conf validation and is not threshold-specific. Repeating optimisation overwrites the CSV/plots under this dataset slug.
